title: Mythic Adventure
description: A immersive modpack combining magic, technology and adventure. Build machines with Create, master spells with Ars Nouveau, explore new dimensions and choose your origin to shape your playstyle.
body:
Mythic Adventure is a carefully crafted modpack that blends magic, technology and exploration into one cohesive experience.
# ⚙️ Technology
Automate your world with Create — build contraptions, trains and factories. Expand your storage with Applied Energistics 2, Sophisticated Storage and Tom's Simple Storage.
# 🔮 Magic
Cast spells with Ars Nouveau, brew potions with Bewitchment, explore runic magic with Hex Casting and discover magical artifacts across the world.
# ⚔️ Adventure
Choose your Origin and play as a unique race with special abilities. Fight through redesigned dungeons, explore the Twilight Forest, the Aether and face new creatures from Alex's Mobs.
# 🗺️ Exploration
Discover breathtaking biomes with Terralith and Biomes O' Plenty, find hidden structures from YUNG's collection and navigate with Xaero's Minimap.
# 
# 📦 Features

90+ mods
Fabric 1.20.1
Optimized with Sodium & Lithium
RPG class system
Multiple magic systems
